mappings.explanation: Root manifests resolve approved config versions and governed feature flags directly.
Fresh child manifests must not masquerade as reuse even when they resolve to the same bytes.
Replay reuses the historical frozen config basis exactly and preserves source lineage explicitly.
Same-attempt recovery rebinds to the interrupted manifest's config freeze without re-resolving live providers.
Historical explicit reuse stays distinct from fresh resolution even when the frozen surface is still current.
